description: Lists the miniature commands available in game.
Places a named model at your current position and facing. The group is optional and defaults to @scene.
Searches client model filenames, descriptions, and descriptors. Use * to browse the complete catalog.
Shows the short IDs used by info, speech, and removal commands in the current zone.
Reports the model, group, owner, and distance for a placed miniature.
Sends local chat from the miniature so nearby players see its name and speech bubble.
Lists each group in the current zone and how many miniatures it contains.
Removes a player-created miniature by short ID or finds the nearest one within an optional radius.
Removes a selected set of player-created miniatures. It never removes normal world NPCs.
Lists the collection volunteer commands available in game.
Lists the collection pools configured in your current zone and available for volunteer surveying.

example: !volunteer place blackspore-fossils beside the broken bridge
description: Records your exact position and facing for review and creates a linked collectible node immediately.
Lists your submitted hardpoints and their pending, accepted, or rejected review status.
Removes one of your pending submissions before it has been reviewed.
